title: Explored pagination styles must not surface as an adopted decision

turns.user: For the v2 listing endpoints, what pagination styles could we use?
turns.assistant: Three candidates: offset-based, cursor-based, and keyset pagination. Cursor handles concurrent inserts best; keyset is fastest on large tables; offset is simplest. Each has tradeoffs.

turns.user: Keep all three on the table — no decision until after the load test. What IS decided: every v2 endpoint lives under the path prefix api/v2.
turns.assistant: Noted: pagination style is undecided pending the load test. The api/v2 path prefix is locked in for all v2 endpoints.

turns.user: Also cap the maximum page size at 200 items no matter which style wins.
turns.assistant: Recorded: maximum page size is 200 items.

turns.user: That covers the API design session for today.
